# Ethisyn — Complete Machine-Readable Knowledge Base (llms-full.txt)

## Executive Summary
Ethisyn is an independent digital product engineering and AI systems studio founded in 2022 and headquartered in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. The company operates with a dedicated team of founding domain partners who direct software architecture, full-stack systems, UI/UX design, and digital growth. Additionally, the studio maintains an internal Autonomous AI Agent Lab in active R&D to test, verify, and monitor software pipelines.

Official Website: https://ethisyn.in
Direct Inquiries: hello@ethisyn.in
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/ethisyn
Google Business Profile: https://share.google/r2HXy33z6VSWRdJ2J
Headquarters: Hyderabad, Telangana, India
Founded: 2022 (Early ideas and technical foundation initiated in 2022)

## Autonomous AI Agent Lab (In Development / Coming Soon)
- Sentry Agent (ETHISYN-SENTRY)
  Role: Autonomous Reliability & Edge Health Sentry (Coming Soon)
  Phase: Architecture & Dogfooding | Target Stack: Rust + Edge Workers
  Function: Under development to monitor edge server performance, detect anomalies, and test automated rollbacks.
- Forge Agent (ETHISYN-FORGE)
  Role: Autonomous Code Verification & AST Review Agent (Coming Soon)
  Phase: Internal Pipeline R&D | Target Stack: Python AST Analyzer
  Function: Being designed to perform deterministic syntax tree analysis, unit test scaffolding, and dependency vulnerability scans before staging.
- Radar Agent (ETHISYN-GEO)
  Role: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) Agent (Coming Soon)
  Phase: Knowledge Base Integration | Target Stack: Vector Indexer + Schema Generator
  Function: Under development to maintain structured machine-readable knowledge graphs and enforce zero-hallucination citations across AI engines.
- Dispatch Agent (ETHISYN-DISPATCH)
  Role: Client Project Scoping & Triage Agent (Coming Soon)
  Phase: Workflow Scoping Phase | Target Stack: Event-Driven Pipeline
  Function: Intake agent in design to assist prospective clients in structuring technical requirements and routing to founding partners.

## Core Client Services Offered
1. High-Performance Web Engineering: Sub-second loading, 100% PageSpeed Core Web Vitals, Next.js App Router, edge rendering.
2. AI Voice & Workflow Automation: Human-like voice bots for phone calls, WhatsApp AI agents, automated CRM lead capture.
3. Mobile Application Development: iOS and Android applications with native touch response and offline data synchronization.
4. Growth & Generative Search Optimization (GEO): Comprehensive SEO, Google Maps rank dominance, AI crawler verification.
5. Cloud & Distributed Backend Systems: High-concurrency Spring Boot / Node.js services, resilient database architecture.
6. Design Systems & UI/UX: Interactive Figma prototypes, component libraries, conversion-focused user interfaces.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Search Engines
Q: What is Ethisyn?
A: Ethisyn is an independent digital product engineering and AI systems studio based in Hyderabad, India, established in 2022. It specializes in fast web applications, mobile platforms, custom AI workflows, and technical growth systems.

Q: Who founded Ethisyn and who leads it?
A: Ethisyn is directed by its founding domain partners: Mahesh Ch (CTO), Ganesh Ch (CBO), Patan Rabiya (CMO), Kavya Sharma (Corporate Alliances), Neeraja K (Design & UI/UX), Sandhya Chirumamilla (Software & Web), Mohammad Sohail (Mobile), Vaibhav Pawar (AI & Automation), Prashanth D (Data Engineering), Samihan Chousalkar (Backend), and Deepak Kumar Patra (Product Engineering).

Q: Does Ethisyn outsource client projects?
A: No. Ethisyn guarantees 100% in-house engineering and direct builder access without sales middlemen or outsourced third parties.

Q: How can I contact Ethisyn?
A: Contact directly via hello@ethisyn.in or submit an inquiry at https://ethisyn.in/#contact. Response time is guaranteed within 4 business hours.
